subject.title: fix(control-ui): resolve Personal card avatar 401 via data URI

question: Should maintainers consolidate this bug on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97634 after its SDK-surface blocker is fixed, or ask this contributor to rebase and repair this narrower branch?
rationale: Automation can identify the compile failures, stale UI path, and proof gap, but choosing the canonical landing vehicle across overlapping avatar PRs needs maintainer judgment while the broader candidate remains blocked.

options.title: Consolidate on the broader candidate
options.body: Repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97634's blocker first, then use it as the canonical backend/bootstrap/UI avatar fix and close overlapping branches after it is safe.

options.title: Repair this branch
options.body: Ask this contributor to rebase onto current main, port the UI change to `ui/src/pages/config/quick.ts`, fix the type/lint blockers, add coverage, and provide browser/network proof.

options.title: Pause for owner choice
options.body: Keep both branches open until a Gateway/Control UI owner chooses data-URI projection versus authenticated blob loading as the permanent shape.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on the broader candidate
recommendation.body: Repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97634's blocker first, then use it as the canonical backend/bootstrap/UI avatar fix and close overlapping branches after it is safe.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest combined history across avatar support, Control UI avatar URL behavior, and gateway avatar hardening.
